result.topic_en: Excerpt notes, copied from a review in the Heidelberger Jahrbücher 1860, of Allihn's article on the life and writings of J. F. Herbart; they cover sources for Herbart's biography, his turn away from Fichte's system, and a list of members of the Herbartian school.
